summary: Scoped Firebase auditor assessment of debtor-master authority, overlapping fallback rules, legacy ledger writes and financial branch linkage. Authenticated baseline probes reproduced 22 unauthorized operations among 25 original cases, plus separate cross-branch and inactive-Finance legacy collections. Repairs pass 59 authenticated authority controls and 19 recognition scenarios. The resource-map compaction experiments were rejected after Operational Inventory exceeded the 1,000-expression runtime limit; the last behavior-passing transformer is restored. Actual hosted compiled-size certification remains blocked and is not inferred from this score.

findings.issue: Some optional CRM contact and free-text fields, and schemas in unaudited fallback collections, lack explicit per-field length/type bounds. Credit-limit UGX, payment terms and protected welfare state are validated in this scope.
findings.recommendation: Continue collection-specific payload hardening without weakening current financial or role constraints.

resolved.check: Authority Source / Business Logic vs Rules
resolved.issue: No-access and view-only users could create or edit canonical debtor masters through the generic tenant fallback.
resolved.repair: Dedicated active-staff, tenant, optional branch, primary/secondary-role and owner-approved custom-realm checks. Restricted Marketing consent/registration and custom Finance/POS master-reading flows retain positive controls.

resolved.issue: The clients wildcard fallback bypassed the protected atomic welfare balance update and allowed arbitrary spending resets or allocation grants.
resolved.repair: Exclude clients/institutions from fallback; ordinary CRM updates cannot alter welfare balances/limits; the existing independently linked atomic correction remains the separate authorized path.

resolved.issue: Debtor masters could be deleted despite outstanding historical source references.
resolved.repair: Hard deletion denied; authorized UI archives status/care_status instead. Existing receivables remain verified and outstanding after archival.

resolved.issue: Finance from another tenant could create, mutate or delete supplier_payables and the three old credit-ledger collections.
resolved.repair: These unused direct-client legacy posting paths are read-only, with existing tenant-scoped Finance reporting preserved. Active invoice/GRN/supplier settlement contracts remain unchanged.

resolved.issue: An HQ-only Finance identity could settle a Masaka legacy debt through a correctly linked raw bank batch without reading that debtor document.
resolved.repair: Debt update independently requires source-branch authority; negative acceptance asserts bank, debt and movement all roll back. Existing authorized legacy settlement remains positive-tested.

resolved.check: Business Logic vs Rules / Generated Artifact Integrity
resolved.issue: Identifier substitution could rewrite permission-method names when a helper parameter shared a name such as write.
resolved.repair: Permission-method tokens are excluded from alpha-renaming; the regression covers all seven permission methods. Existing authenticated positive workflows validate the emitted rules.

resolved.issue: Inactive Finance could still collect legacy debt; contradictory active/status flags could retain operator authority.
resolved.repair: Independent active-profile guards on credit reads and legacy receipts; consistent active-state validation with four legacy/contradictory-state controls.

compilerInvestigation.observed: Complex candidate/control requests return HTTP 503 at about 5.1 seconds; minimal/source-size-matched deny-all controls succeed quickly. Retaining functions with permissions denied compiled in 3.5 seconds.
compilerInvestigation.inference: A complexity/internal-deadline problem is plausible; a general Firebase outage and source-filename causation are not established.
compilerInvestigation.validation: Production source name and bytes remain exact. Shared immutable exact source may be referenced read-only by an owned unbound probe; unproven source ownership forbids deletion. Actual release success and exact probe linkage remain mandatory.

rejectedCandidates.issue: Match-local resource getters exceeded Operational Inventory's 1,000-expression budget; credit and payroll controls passed.
Equivalent inlining of three inventory/procurement role predicates did not resolve the runtime expression regression.

compilerInvestigation.restoration: Restore authored rules, compactor and structural tests exactly to behavior-passing dac45dd1ca0cce9556f7bf2f28f5367b4da242df. Retain all audited authorization, active-state and atomic branch guards. Do not accept source-byte reduction as executable proof.

isolation.interpretation: Broader combined graphs fail while individual families pass; aggregate complexity/interactions are supported, but vendor root cause and whole-application executable fit are not established.

compilerInvestigation.targetedSimplification: Consolidate equivalent generic-fallback exclusions and remove unreachable staff/client/institution identity branches behind exclusions. Historical policy fixture proves the exact read/write protected sets. No account or debtor authority is weakened. Whole-candidate hosted validation remains mandatory.

limitations: Scoped assessment; full application-wide security sign-off is not claimed.
Live Martin Pharma workspace/UI acceptance and production deployment are not performed.
The original Phase 3 generalized transfer pathway remains separately uncertified.
59 auditor cases and existing financial/recognition regressions are controlled emulator tests.
